_meta.description: Outbound e-invoicing (T4 UBL/Peppol capability reserved by bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core). Adds the Peppol delivery-status field group to ARInvoice plus a Peppol participant id on CustomerMaster so the transmission port can resolve a debtor's Peppol identity the same way PurchaseOrderService resolves a supplier's via the Vendor schema. IMPORTANT: this fragment intentionally does NOT declare a second `x-openregister-lifecycle` block on ARInvoice. OpenRegister supports exactly ONE `x-openregister-lifecycle` annotation per schema (single top-level key, deep-merged across register.d fragments); ARInvoice's existing lifecycle is already fully declared (field: lifecycleState) in add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json. A second full lifecycle block keyed on a different field would deep-merge into the SAME object and silently clobber the canonical `field`/`initialState` scalars (fragment merge is scalar-overwrite, filename-order-dependent: see add-shillinq-rule-compliance-guard.json for the safe pattern, which only ever adds a `transitions.<name>.requires` leaf onto the existing lifecycle). The delivery sub-lifecycle is therefore declared as DATA under the documentation-only `x-shillinq-delivery-substates` extension (ignored by OR's LifecycleAnnotationValidator/TransitionEngine. No merge collision risk) and enforced imperatively by EInvoiceService (not-sent -> queued) and PeppolDeliveryStatusListener (queued/sent -> sent/delivered/rejected/failed and back to queued on re-send). See tasks.md Deviations.

deliveryStatus.description: Peppol e-invoice delivery status. Orthogonal to lifecycleState: an invoice can be issued/overdue/paid independently of its deliveryStatus. Defaults to 'not-sent' so pre-existing invoices without this field remain valid.
deliveryStatus.title: Delivery Status

transmissionId.description: Peppol message/transmission id (URN, e.g. urn:uuid:.) returned by the transmission port on a successful submit.
transmissionId.title: Transmission ID

payloadFileUri.description: Docudesk/Files FK URI of the stored UBL / PDF-A3 hybrid artefact transmitted over Peppol. Never inline XML on the event bus.
payloadFileUri.title: Payload File URI

deliveryDetail.description: Last delivery-status 'detail' message received from the access point (rejection/failure reason, or acceptance note).
deliveryDetail.title: Delivery Detail

buyerPeppolParticipantId.description: Resolved Peppol participant id (scheme:identifier, e.g. 0106:00000000 for a B2G municipality) for the ARInvoice's debtor, mirroring the seller-side identifiers already carried by add-shillinq-invoice-lines.json. Populated from CustomerMaster.peppolParticipantId via the transmission port's lookupParticipant and persisted here for audit once a send succeeds.
buyerPeppolParticipantId.title: Buyer Peppol Participant ID

x-shillinq-delivery-substates._comment: Documentation-only state graph for ARInvoice.deliveryStatus (REQ-AR-011). NOT an x-openregister-lifecycle block — see _meta.description. Enforced imperatively by EInvoiceService + PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

not-sent.label: Not sent
not-sent.description: No Peppol transmission has been attempted, or the last attempt fell back to PDF + email.

queued.label: Queued
queued.description: Pre-send validation passed and nl.conduction.peppol.outbound.requested was emitted; awaiting access-point acceptance.

sent.label: Sent
sent.description: The access point accepted the transmission (delivery.status: sent).

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.description: The recipient access point confirmed delivery (delivery.status: delivered). Terminal.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: The access point or recipient rejected the document (delivery.status: rejected). The finance operator is notified.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Transmission failed before the access point could process it (delivery.status: failed).

queue.label: Send e-invoice
queue.description: Operator triggers Send e-invoice after pre-send validation passes. Enforced by EInvoiceService.

accept.label: Access point accepts
accept.description: nl.conduction.peppol.delivery.status status: sent. Enforced by PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

confirm.label: Recipient confirms
confirm.description: nl.conduction.peppol.delivery.status status: delivered. Enforced by PeppolDeliveryStatusListener.

requeue-rejected.label: Re-send after correction
requeue-rejected.description: Operator re-triggers Send e-invoice after correcting the rejection cause.

requeue-failed.label: Re-send
requeue-failed.description: Operator re-triggers Send e-invoice after a transmission failure.

peppolParticipantId.description: Debtor's Peppol participant id (scheme:identifier, e.g. 0106:00000000 for a Dutch municipality B2G participant, or 9944:nl123456789b01 for a commercial NL participant). Resolved by Peppol\LogPeppolTransmissionAdapter:lookupParticipant, mirroring Vendor.peppolParticipantId on the PO/supplier side. Absent = the debtor has no known Peppol identity; Send e-invoice falls back to PDF + email.
peppolParticipantId.title: Peppol Participant ID
